title: A Place That Knows Nobody
summary: At Rowan Hold, no one mistakes Brandon for anybody. The community's attention is on Nessa Rowan, who has been chosen to inherit a family obligation she does not want and intends to leave instead.

panelPlan.text: Rowan Hold is a close agricultural settlement gathered around shade trees and low stone houses. An exposed black Sunforge arc crosses the common yard and is used as ordinary seating.
Brandon, Eva and Jessie enter expecting another recognition. People glance at them, then go back to a loud family argument around Nessa and her mother Ada.
Eva waits for somebody to call Brandon a name. Nobody does. Jessie notices Nessa's packed bag instead.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: They're looking. They just don't care.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: I could get used to this.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ada Rowan
dialogueInline.text: You said that before they chose you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: They chose me because they thought I'd stop saying it.

title: Chosen to Stay
summary: Nessa explains that the family selected her to maintain the household records and mediate kin disputes after her aunt's death. It is an honor that would also keep her at Rowan Hold indefinitely. Jessie understands the trap without treating the community as cruel.

panelPlan.text: Ada picks up Jessie's recognition of Nessa's sentence and argues that Jessie therefore understands why the family chose her. Nessa shows Eva and Jessie the family room where births, debts, marriages and old agreements are kept in hand-written ledgers.
Ada explains that somebody trustworthy has to remember what everyone promised when tempers were cooler.
Nessa says she loves these people and still does not want the life they have decided proves she loves them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ada Rowan
dialogueInline.text: Then you know why we chose her.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: I know why you think you did.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ada Rowan
dialogueInline.text: Mira trusted her with every name we have.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: She trusted me to help. She did not appoint me from the grave.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Could you do it for a year?

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: My uncle said a year. My mother said until they train someone. Nobody has named the someone.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: How long did Mira do it?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: That's what I'd be worried about.

dialogueInline.speaker: Ada Rowan
dialogueInline.text: And what would you have us do? Forget everything?

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: No. Figure it out without deciding I already volunteered.

title: What Jessie Notices
summary: While Brandon helps with an ordinary meal and nobody projects a false identity onto him, Eva realizes Jessie is more invested in Nessa's decision than she is admitting.

panelPlan.text: Nessa's insistence that she never volunteered sends Eva's attention to the already-packed bag. Brandon sits with two children shelling beans badly but patiently. Nobody asks who he used to be.
Across the yard, Jessie checks Nessa's packed bag for weight and quietly removes things that will be useless on the road.
Eva joins her and starts asking about Nessa, then notices she is really asking about Jessie.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: She packed like she meant it. Three books.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Did somebody do that for you?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: No. That's how I learned about the socks.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: It was enough to get me on the road.

title: A Vote Against Her
summary: The Rowan family tries to resolve the dispute by voting on whether Nessa should accept the role. Brandon points out, gently, that a vote about somebody else's life cannot create consent.

panelPlan.text: Nessa takes Jessie's admission that wanting to leave was enough and says it is enough for her too. Family members gather in the common yard and begin an earnest vote, each explaining why Nessa is needed.
Nessa stands outside the circle that is deciding her future. Jessie is visibly irritated but lets Nessa speak first.
Brandon, asked whether travelers have a custom for this, says the obvious thing the family has managed not to say.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: Then it's enough for me too.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: You're taking a vote on whether I get to leave.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: Does the person carrying it get a vote?

dialogueInline.speaker: Brandon
dialogueInline.text: Gladly. I only asked because Nessa wasn't inside your circle.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: I love you. I'm leaving anyway.

title: The Empty Chair
summary: Once Nessa's departure is treated as real, the family begins asking a different question: how to distribute the work among people who are actually willing. Jessie helps Nessa prepare without romanticizing the road.

panelPlan.text: The ledger room now has several relatives arguing over which pieces of the work each can realistically take.
Nessa and Ada pack together in uneasy silence before Ada finally adds a family recipe book to Nessa's bag.
Eva expects Jessie to congratulate Nessa. Jessie instead warns her about loneliness, money and the fact that leaving does not make every decision correct.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: You make the road sound miserable.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: You should put that on a recruiting poster.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nessa
dialogueInline.text: Why did you stay out there?

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: Because when I woke up wanting to leave, I could.

title: Nothing Happened to Brandon
summary: The trio leaves Rowan Hold after two uneventful days. Eva is almost offended that Brandon was simply Brandon the entire time; Jessie recognizes the value of that fact.

panelPlan.text: Nessa walks out on a different road with another small caravan. Her family watches from the yard; some wave, some do not, and nobody pretends to be happy about it.
Brandon says goodbye to people who know him only as Brandon. A child returns the knife he loaned for supper prep.
On the road, Eva looks back at the obvious Sunforge arc in the common yard and finally admits the lack of an event is evidence too.

dialogueInline.speaker: Eva
dialogueInline.text: Fine. Here's mine: two whole days.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: There was a Sunforge in the yard.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jessie
dialogueInline.text: There was a goat on it most of yesterday.
